title: Enchanted Wooden Bow
description: A beautifully crafted fantasy bow made of curved wood covered in green moss and vines, adorned with glowing purple flowers. A matching quiver of arrows with purple fletching hangs beside it, both emitting a soft ethereal blue and purple glow against a dark, textured background.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy longbow made from curved wood covered in green moss and vines, featuring glowing purple star-shaped flowers growing from it, with a matching quiver of arrows with purple fletching suspended by glowing magical strings, emitting soft blue and purple ethereal light, set against a dark textured background with subtle particles, in a mystical fantasy style.
